svg.title: Tire (tp::tire): traction and motion resistance on soil (Brixius)

g.text: Tire (tp::tire): traction and motion resistance on soil (Brixius)
+traction(const Params&, wheel_m_s, ground_m_s, load_n, const Surface&) : Traction
+driven_rolling_resistance(const Size&, load_n, slip_ratio, const Surface&) : double
+thrown_soil_m3_s(const Size&, load_n, slip_ratio, wheel_m_s, const Surface&) : double
Bn = CI b d / W · (1 + 5 δ/h) / (1 + 3 b/d)
μ(s) = g · limit (1 - e^(-mobility_rate Bn)) (1 - e^(-slip_rate |s|)) (1 - f s²)
thrown soil: width · diameter · driven resistance · |wheel surface speed|
force over a step = force_n + force_per_slip_speed * change in slip speed
(linearly implicit; slope >= 0, so explicit beyond the peak)
